description: The driven, damped spring again, sampled at 2000 points spread over the driving frequency w and the damping c by a Sobol sequence instead of a grid. Left: where the samples fell, coloured by the lag, which turns from 0 to π across the resonance at w ≈ 1, sharply where damping is low. Right: every sample's amplitude against w, as points: low damping reaches highest. Try design random or Latin hypercube, or sweep a third parameter, in the sweep bar.

blocks.name: spring
equations: # steady swing of a driven, damped spring: mass m, stiffness k, damping c, force F at frequency w
